mapper.insert: INSERT INTO appointment (visitor_id, appointment_time, visit_reason, host_name, host_dept, status, create_time) VALUES (#{visitorId}, #{appointmentTime}, #{visitReason}, #{hostName}, #{hostDept}, #{status}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT a.*, v.name AS visitor_name, v.phone AS visitor_phone FROM appointment a LEFT JOIN visitor v ON a.visitor_id = v.id WHERE a.id = #{id}

SELECT a.*, v.name AS visitor_name, v.phone AS visitor_phone FROM appointment a LEFT JOIN visitor v ON a.visitor_id = v.id
AND a.status = #{status}
AND (v.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR v.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.host_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY a.create_time DESC
SELECT a.*, v.name AS visitor_name, v.phone AS visitor_phone FROM appointment a LEFT JOIN visitor v ON a.visitor_id = v.id WHERE v.phone = #{phone} ORDER BY a.create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE appointment SET status = #{status}, reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, reviewer_id = #{reviewerId}, review_time = #{reviewTime}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
